item.title: [7] Quantum Coulomb Liquids of Different Rank in the Breathing Pyrochlore Antiferromagnet
item.description:
Last authors: Simon Trebst, Yasir Iqbal

Authors: Lasse Gresista, Daniel Lozano-Gómez, Matthias Vojta, Simon Trebst, Yasir Iqbal

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Materials-relevant theory on quantum spin liquids in pyrochlore antiferromagnet.

Tags: #theory #antiferromagnetism #quantummagnetism #spinliquid

Abstract: A minimal, materials-relevant spin-1/2 model on the breathing pyrochlore lattice, tuned solely by symmetry-allowed Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interactions, gives robust quantum realizations of both rank-1 and rank-2 U(1) Coulomb liquids.
